# Wise Women Use AI

> Practical AI education and consulting for women in business, founded by
> Kelly Hartley, an AI consultant and educator based in Melbourne, Australia.
> Warm, jargon-free teaching that works around real life, not hustle culture.

Kelly Hartley is a British-Australian business owner who runs her own
businesses on AI (primarily Claude) and teaches women in their 40s and 50s
to do the same. WWUAI is not another ChatGPT course. It teaches Claude
specifically, with a focus on simple systems women can actually stick to.
Kelly also works one-to-one as an AI consultant, based in Melbourne and
working online with women across Australia.

## Work with Kelly
- [AI Consulting, Melbourne and online](https://www.wisewomenuseai.com/work): One-to-one AI setup and strategy sessions, and a four-week done-with-you systems build
- [About Kelly Hartley](https://www.wisewomenuseai.com/about): Who Kelly is and why she built WWUAI

## Community and membership
- [Skool Community](https://www.wisewomenuseai.com/community): Free to join. The Unfair Advantage is the paid membership inside ($49/month) with the full library of tools, prompts and workflows
- [Free monthly workshop](https://www.wisewomenuseai.com/workshop): Live online workshop where attendees set up real tools and leave having built the first piece themselves

## Products
- [The Notion Advantage Pack](https://www.wisewomenuseai.com/notion-advantage): A ready-built Notion business system ($99 AUD launch price)

## Free guides and starters
- [Claude, Clearly](https://www.wisewomenuseai.com/guide): Free guide to getting started with Claude
- [Switch to Claude](https://www.wisewomenuseai.com/switch): Free guide for ChatGPT users moving to Claude
- [Claude Starter Kit](https://www.wisewomenuseai.com/starter): Free starter resources for brand-new Claude users
